toolchain.scope: existing local standard-library and quality installations; no install

passed.optimized_children: crash/race/mutation child invocations inherit -O; explicit mutation raises survive optimization
passed.aggregate_interpreter_scope: Existing aggregate child commands retain normal Python; separate full -O suite and propagated -O crash/race/mutation children supply optimized evidence.

real_boundaries: durable operation/file bindings before mutating requests
fake_boundaries: separate synthetic HTTP SQLite service, never Slack
injected exact-request allow/deny callbacks, not real owner/Core authority
initial_validation_failures_resolved: Ruff/import ordering/format and strict test typing diagnostics corrected before final runs

An attempted STATUS/provenance/index update invalidated the existing exact audit hashes. Those edits were reverted and the complete preexisting records/checksums retained byte-for-byte; new evidence is standalone.
blocked: authenticated account-bound transport and real Slack response qualification
production sanitization and general multi-attachment behavior
limits: All observations remain unqualified_wire_observation, never accepted/delivered/mirrored.
Unknown or missing readback is not authoritative absence or permission to resend.
One store must be shared by all callers; no global uniqueness across stores.
Interrupted partial uploads conservatively stop; this is at-most-once attempts, not exactly-once delivery or liveness.
Uploaded content and capability URLs are not retained, so the API does not resume incomplete steps.
Injected authorizers/transports are trusted application seams, not authenticated authority/provider evidence.
Authorization and readback are sequential observations, not distributed atomicity or a current remote snapshot.
Schema triggers protect this API, not arbitrary direct SQL, privileged schema changes or replaced files.
Previous STATUS/provenance/audit records remain historical bare-wire/component coverage; new standalone evidence does not promote their live/runtime gates.
protected_scope: Every preexisting tracked file except README.md is byte-identical to base, including source, STATUS, provenance, evidence/checksum manifests, workflows, pins and gates.
